modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
follow safe working practices while dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
carry out routine check of the machine for identifying potential hazards
use appropriate protective clothing/equipment for specific tasks and work
follow safety hazards and preventive techniques during fire drill
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
ensure workstation and equipment are regularly clean and sanitized
clean hands with soap, alcohol-based sanitizer regularly
avoid contact with ill people and self-isolate in a similar situation
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
follow stress and anxiety management techniques

modules.module_title: Perform work as per quality standards

pcs.pc_description: ensure that work is accomplished as per the requirements within the specified timeline
ensure team goals are given preference over individual goals
follow the fundamentals of 5S for waste management
segregate waste into different categories
follow processes specified for disposal of hazardous waste
identify recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous waste
dispose non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste appropriately at identified location
identify ways to optimize usage of material in various tasks/activities/processes
check for spills/leakages in various tasks/activities/processes
plug spills/leakages and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
check if the equipment/machine is functioning normally before commencing work and rectify wherever required
report malfunctioning (fumes/ sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment
ensure electrical equipment and appliances are properly connected and turned off when not in use

pcs.pc_description: interpret the inspection check sheet and coordinate with the superior for confirming inspection tasks and inspection criteria based on the standards for product/process
identify and arrange testing equipment, measuring instruments, gauges, parts etc. required during the quality inspection process
ensure that tools, gauges and measuring instruments to be used for inspection process are calibrated
follow safety practices recommended by organisation during quality inspection process
conduct and guide the quality control assistant in conducting the visual inspection of part or product for scratches, dents, damages, packing etc. as per the norms and quality standards

conduct and guide the quality control assistant in conducting the dimensional and functional check of part or product by using inspection and measuring instrument such as vernier caliper, bore gauge, Go/NOGO gauge, micrometer etc.
judge the part or product through reference for feel, touch, sound, smell, etc. if the measurement is not possible
maintain and preserve the tested samples to track inspection history of automotive part or product tested and use it as defect/limit samples
ensure that the sticker/number/label is placed on the inspected automotive part or product
conduct automotive process inspection to verify the process control items by using pressure gauge, temperature gauge, voltmeter/ ammeter etc.
prepare first-off inspection report by referring to process inspection standard/process parameter sheet/control plan
record the observations of the inspection and update the records such as inspection report, charts in graphical pattern and other documents, manually or electronically as per the SOP
raise a scrap note and ensure that scrapped part or product in the scrap yard is disposed-off as per the organisational specified procedure

modules.module_title: Co-ordinate with the team, and line incharge/supervisor

pcs.pc_description: work as a CFT member of the team formed for problem solving and corrective actions pertaining to the products handled
collect data related to the problems identified during inspection process, analyse it with team and identify the corrective actions for clearing the discrepancies
coordinate with the respective process line leader/supervisor and implement corrective action for discrepancies identified in the inspection report
coordinate with the team and identify opportunities for improvements in productivity, quality, cost, safety and morale
verify the daily check items for e.g. poka yoke, mould functioning, fixture condition etc.
